message: Substantive Commission 05 focus: all four pilot cases passed at t=4 and t=5. the lead author now wants to discuss joining this study with the existing figure. Please examine optimizer selection in irreversible_0.1_0.1: t=4 native mean chooses root [0,1], has mean target loss 0.236 and deficiency 0.236 to the frozen Brier reference; the native-minimax collector has the same mean loss within numerical bounds and near-zero error to that reference. At t=5 IG chooses root [1,0] while Brier mixes [0.5,0.5], with the same IG value to displayed precision but markedly different reference capabilities. These look like flat-optimum/tie effects, not an intrinsic all-optima failure. Read source/checks under budget_campaign/results/pilot_h{4,5}__case_02__*. A joint pilot preview and bound snapshot are in budget_campaign/interim_20260924_024603/. Please address the interpretation and what compatibility evidence is still needed in the existing requested review; no numerical workers or shared edits.
